name: discern
comment: The application is web/. Vercel's Root Directory is set to 'web', so Vercel reads web/package.json and web/vercel.json and never installs or builds from this file — it exists only for local convenience scripts. Do not add a build command, a vercel.json or dependencies at this level: a second deployment config here is what left /vercel.json silently inert for months, taking the from.enuid.com redirect with it.
